text:
incidents-bot: ALERT · kv-cache paging surge detected for shard-group tp-7 · severity: P1
incidents-bot: symptoms: 10x NVMe paging ops, p95 token latency up 3x, NCCL timeouts on 3/8 tensor-parallel workers, error rate spike. Auto-ingested by pager at 02:15 UTC.

oncall_tf: I'm on it — taking command. @samira @matt please join. Quick ask: can someone grep change history for continuous-batching / kv-cache config changes in the last deploy window?

samira: I see a batching tweak rolled at 01:50 UTC by rollout-bot: `continuous_batching.enabled=true`, `max_batch_tokens=65536`, `batch_coalesce=all_shards`. That coalesce flag looks suspicious for TP config.

matt: moving to mitigation steps. Hypothesis: cross-shard coalescing + larger max_batch_tokens caused uneven KV cache eviction / cache blow-up on some TP partitions, pushing more pages to NVMe and triggering NCCL congestion.

matt: immediate mitigation plan (taking action now):
- disable `batch_coalesce` for tp-7
- set `continuous_batching.max_batch_tokens=16384` (rollback to safer bound)
- throttle `kv_cache.prefetch=off` on affected pool

samira: running quick dry-run commands on staging to confirm safe rollback.

samira: command to patch config on the control-plane (will apply to affected model group):
```bash
redwoodctl config set --pool tp-7 continuous_batching.batch_coalesce=none \
  --pool tp-7 continuous_batching.max_batch_tokens=16384
```

samira: also enabling per-shard cache caps to prevent future blowups: `kv_cache.max_entries_per_shard=2e6`

ops-bot: ACTION_LOG · user=samira action=patch_config target=tp-7 status=started

loggie: throwing up the relevant metric queries for visibility: GC paging ops, KV cache size per shard, NCCL handshakes. Sharing quick links: https://grafana.internal/redwood/d/kv-paging

matt: squashing the hot path — I'm going to temporarily pin TP routing for production traffic to balanced-shard-mode while we stabilize. That should reduce uneven partitioning causing hotspots.

deploy-bot: DEPLOY STARTED · patch=rollback-batching-tp7 triggered_by=samira

incidents-bot: NOTE · customer-impact: a subset of long-running generation jobs (>=8k tokens) saw degraded throughput; a handful (<5) enterprise customers reported elevated latency and occasional 5xx. No data exfiltration reported.

emily-cs: flagged top 3 affected customers (enterprise acct ids 1012, 1044, 1089). Outreach: sending templated update and offering dedicated compensatory capacity.

priya-product: prioritizing rollback. Also suggest we notify any customers with pinned model versions so they can opt into fallback to a non-coalesced model.

ops-bot: ACTION_LOG · user=matt action=route_pin target=tp-7 mode=balanced-shard-mode status=applied

deploy-bot: DEPLOY SUCCESS · patch=rollback-batching-tp7 duration=65s commit=2fa3b9c

samira: rollback applied. Observability notes: KV cache entries on shards 7,8 trending down. NVMe paging ops falling back to baseline. NCCL timeouts count down from 3 to 0 in last 2 mins.

matt: confirming impact metrics: p95 token latency back to within SLO, error rate returning to normal. Marking customer impact window 02:12–02:58 UTC.

derek-ml: quick postmortem notes from model/TP perspective: the `batch_coalesce=all_shards` heuristic amplified skew when per-shard token distributions are heavy-tailed. For TP setups we need a shard-aware coalescing guard (don't coalesce across >N shards). I'll open a follow-up RFC.

loggie: saved graphs & attached logs: `kv_cache_evictions.log`, `nccl_error_dump.log` in incident folder `/incidents/1834509999/`

incidents-bot: RESOLVE_CHECK · condition: stable p95 latency for 10m and NCCL errors=0 -> currently true. Marking incident as mitigated; will keep on-call monitoring for 1h.

oncall_tf: thanks @samira @matt @derek-ml and ops-bot. Handoff: I'll stay on monitor watch for 1h, then pass to next oncall at 04:15 UTC.

emily-cs: outreach sent to affected customers, included root-cause summary and ETA for permanent fix (RFC + guardrails)

priya-product: note for roadmap — add per-deployment safe batching profiles and a pre-deploy shard-skew simulator in CI.

matt: followups tracked in GH: redwood/infra#4521 and redwood/runtime#378. Also creating a post-incident task to add automated alerts for `batch_coalesce` config flips on TP pools.

incidents-bot: INCIDENT MITIGATED · severity downgraded to P3; monitoring window started.

oncall_tf: closing thread for now, will reopen if regressions reappear. :white_check_mark:
